claim: In scaled dot-product attention, query-key dot products are multiplied by the square root of the key dimension.
The Transformer relies on recurrence to process sequences.
Multi-head attention uses only one learned projection of queries, keys, and values.
DPR encodes questions and passages using exactly the same encoder parameters.
Sentence-BERT requires comparing every pair of sentences with a cross-encoder at search time.
RAG generates answers without conditioning on retrieved documents.
Positional encoding provides the Transformer with no information about token positions.
Additive attention computes compatibility using a dot product alone.
